case.title: Upgrade from Pro to Business
case.subject: Upgrading our plan
case.text:
Hi,

We're opening a second location next month and will have 8 staff. I think we need to move from Pro to Business. If I upgrade mid-month, do I pay the full $199 straight away or is it prorated?

Thanks,
Olivia Grant
Grant Veterinary
case.why: Plan change with a pricing question; the answer (prorated, Business $199) is in the KB, so prices in the draft are grounded.

output.reply:
Hi Olivia,

Thanks for getting in touch. Upgrades take effect immediately, and you pay a prorated amount for the rest of your current billing period, so you won't be charged the full $199 up front. I can't give an exact figure for your account, but the amount will be prorated.

Business ($199/month) covers up to 20 staff and multiple locations, which fits your plan for a second location and 8 staff (Pro supports up to 5).

To upgrade, the account owner can go to Settings → Billing → Change plan.

Best regards,
Slotwise Support
